title: The US Open Starts in Canada

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: The US Open gets decided in August — in Canada. [exhales] Most fans watch the wrong tournament.

viz.big: THE US OPEN STARTS IN CANADA.

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: Here's the calendar nobody thinks about. Canada, August first. Cincinnati, the eleventh. Then the Open. Same surface, back to back to back.

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: So the guys who show up flying in Toronto and Montreal? That's not a warm-up. That's the form that wins in New York three weeks later.

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: Last summer? Ben Shelton won Canada. Victoria Mboko shocked Osaka for the women's title. Nobody casual was watching either one.

lines.speaker: george
lines.text: So while everyone waits for New York... watch Canada. Whoever's cooking in week one of August — that's your US Open pick, two weeks before the odds catch up.

viz.sub: PICK YOUR CHAMP BEFORE THE ODDS MOVE.

caption: The US Open gets decided in August — in Canada. The hard-court runway most fans ignore, and why week one of August tells you who wins New York.
